item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies turn mostly clear with low temperatures ranging from the upper twenties to the lower thirties and no precipitation expected anywhere in the region. Tomorrow brings mostly clear to partly cloudy conditions, with high temperatures climbing from the upper forties to the mid-fifties and still no chance of rain. Tomorrow night stays partly cloudy with lows in the low to mid-thirties and dry weather continuing throughout the area.
